item.title: U.S. Cannot Legally Impose Tariffs Using Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974
item.description:
📝 Section 122 allows for the president to impose temporary tariffs in the case of fundamental international payments problems. What is a “fundamental international payments problem”. Section 122 does not define the phrase “fundamental international payments problems.
🔗 Read more: https://ielp.worldtradelaw.net/2026/01/guest-post-president-trump-cannot-legally-impose-tariffs-using-section-122-of-the-trade-act-of-1974/
